description: Epoch AI 'AI Capabilities' (benchmarks) dataset — model scores across 51 benchmarks plus the Epoch Capabilities Index.

body.how_to_read: One CSV per benchmark (51 total; sample in files_sample, full list = `ls data/blobs/epoch/benchmarks/`). Each holds model scores over time for that benchmark; epoch_capabilities_index.csv is the aggregate ECI. Columns vary per file — read the header. Capabilities trend context, not chip data.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'AI Capabilities' benchmark export (51 per-benchmark CSVs), cleaned by the epoch_ai ingest, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
